releases.body:
### Changed

- The OpenRouter decision model list adds `cloudflare/clairic`, `morph/reflex` and
  `parallel/decisions-fast:free`. They are unbenchmarked, so selecting one raises a config notice
  ([Reviewer models](docs/REVIEWER-MODELS.md#openrouter)).
- The list drops `inception/mercury-decide`, which OpenRouter no longer serves. A config that
  names `openrouter/inception/mercury-decide` is no longer treated as a System One model.
- Bumped the runtime dependencies `@opencode/client` to 2.2.6 and `semver` to 7.8.6, and the dev
  dependency `@opencode/plugin` to 2.2.6, with `bun.lock` synchronized.
- Bumped the dev dependencies `@biomejs/biome` to 2.6.4, `knip` to 6.44.1 and `tsdown` to 0.23.4,
  and the CodeQL actions to 4.39.3.

### Security

- GHSA-chp3-j5qr-2vfr (`effect` before 4.0.0-beta.103, moderate) is documented as residual
  exposure and ignored by ID in the audit. `@opencode-ai/plugin` pins `effect` 4.0.0-beta.83
  exactly and has no release with the fix; the V1 host supplies that runtime, and this package
  neither ships it nor imports from it ([Supply chain](docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md#the-effect-runtime)).

This release changes no runtime code.

### Added

- `docs/toolkit-page.yaml`, the plugin's page on toolkit.noppu.com.

### Changed

- **Breaking:** the TUI runtime dependencies move from OpenTUI 0.7 to 0.8. `@opentui/core` and
  `@opentui/solid` are pinned at 0.8.2 and `solid-js` at 1.9.18, matching the `@opentui/* >=0.8.0`
  that `@opencode/plugin` peers from 2.2.3. Installs that pin `@opentui/*` or `solid-js`
  themselves, or that run the plugin beside another that expects OpenTUI 0.7, must move with it to
  keep a single Solid runtime. The supported host ranges are unchanged: the real-host matrix
  renders the TUI on every pinned V1 host and on V2 2.0.22 through 2.2.5.
- Bumped the runtime dependency `@opencode/client` and the dev dependency `@opencode/plugin` to
  2.2.5, with `bun.lock` synchronized.
- The real-host matrix adds OpenCode 2.2.5, the first verified V2 host on OpenTUI 0.8.
- The OpenRouter decision model list adds `baseten/elephant-1`, `baseten/joey-1` and
  `baseten/mammoth-1`. They are unbenchmarked, so selecting one raises a config notice
  ([Reviewer models](docs/REVIEWER-MODELS.md#openrouter)).

### Security

- `solid-js` 1.9.18 resolves `seroval` 1.6.12, which fixes GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c,
  GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp, GHSA-97r2-qh9m-474h, GHSA-wp97-x4hv-qvhp, GHSA-7rv5-mrxv-xcr9 and
  GHSA-9wx9-5pv9-3349. The audit no longer ignores any advisory, and the consumer `npm audit`
  gate no longer admits a residual
  ([#112](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/112)).
- GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (`glob`) and GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (`minimatch`), both moderate, are fixed
  only in new majors that upstream doesn't allow yet. Root `overrides` to `glob` 14.0.3 and
  `minimatch` 11.0.4 clear them from this repository's tree. The consumer tree keeps them through
  `@opentui/solid`'s `babel-plugin-module-resolver`, which never calls the vulnerable code here, and
  they are documented as residual exposure
  ([Supply chain](docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md#known-residual-exposure),
  [#128](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/128)).

### Changed

- Bumped the runtime dependency `@opencode/client` to 2.2.2.
- Bumped the dev dependencies `@opencode/plugin` to 2.2.2, `get-east-asian-width` to 1.7.0 and
  `string-width` to 8.3.0, with `bun.lock` synchronized. The `@opentui/*` pins stay at 0.7.0
  because `@opencode/plugin` 2.2.2 still pins them, so the `seroval` residual exposure tracked in
  [#112](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/112) is unchanged.

### Fixed

- The TUI's East Asian Wide table is regenerated from `get-east-asian-width` 1.7.0, so characters
  added as wide in Unicode 18 take two terminal columns when long commands are fitted.

### Changed

- Releases are tagged automatically: every push to `main` reads the `package.json` version and, if
  it is not tagged yet, runs the release checks, then tags the commit `vX.Y.Z` and publishes from
  that tag ([Releasing](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#releasing)).
- New npm package description that more accurately represents what the plugin does.
- Bumped the dev dependencies `@opencode-ai/plugin` and `@opencode-ai/sdk` to 1.19.5, with
  `bun.lock` synchronized (dependency bumps only; no behavior change). The `@opencode-ai/plugin`
  peer range is unchanged.

### Fixed

- The TUI fits long commands by terminal columns, so CJK text and emoji no longer overflow the row
  or lose the end of the command, combining accents no longer cut it short, and a cut never splits
  a flag, an emoji or an accented letter ([#45](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/45)).

### Security

- GHSA-97r2-qh9m-474h, GHSA-wp97-x4hv-qvhp, GHSA-7rv5-mrxv-xcr9 and GHSA-9wx9-5pv9-3349 in
  `seroval` are documented as residual exposure, alongside GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c and
  GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp. `seroval` arrives through `solid-js` 1.9.12, which `@opentui/solid` 0.7.0
  pins exactly. Only the SSR renderer `solid-js/web` imports it, and neither this plugin nor
  OpenTUI loads that renderer, so the vulnerable code is unreachable at runtime
  ([Supply chain](docs/SUPPLY-CHAIN.md#known-residual-exposure)). The upgrade is tracked in
  [#112](https://github.com/noppu-labs/opencode-permission-reviewer/issues/112).
- The audit no longer ignores GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp (`http-cache-semantics`), which GitHub
  withdrew.
